format: PNG source master with WebP runtime delivery generated by the project's existing Sharp dependency
artDirection: Triassic ocean only: marine-first, early Mesozoic natural-history scenes, text-free biome plates.

biomes.gypsum-flats: Milk-turquoise hypersaline shallows, gypsum plates and stromatolite domes.
biomes.conifer-shore: Brackish estuary, Voltzia and horsetails visible through the waterline.
biomes.dasyclad-lagoon: Bright carbonate platform with whorled Diplopora meadows.
biomes.sponge-coral-reef: Early coral tubes, calcareous sponge mounds and reef chambers.
biomes.shell-pavement: Flat-clam pavement, ammonoid shells and low shell mounds.
biomes.margin-channels: Current-cut platform margin with angular breccia blocks.
biomes.reef-front: Dachstein-style reef slope descending into the deep.
biomes.black-basin: Anoxic black mud, slow ash fall and a surface log silhouette.

brand.title: Triassic Triumph
brand.rule: Use the trilogy's engraved black serif lettering with gold and ivory outlines. Frame the title with marine life, shells, coral tubes, crinoid crowns and surface light; never a terrestrial dinosaur poster.
